target_customer: Software companies wanting to onboard users with an AI agent that operates their web app interface
problem: Users get stuck in complex web apps and static product tours do not help.
product_category: AI customer onboarding agent (product named Andoria)

founders.name: Daryl Budiman
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Stanford without details.

technical_complexity.rationale: A web agent that learns an arbitrary app and acts reliably on its interface was hard for browser agents in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: No data or integration lock in was described and incumbents could add agent features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Onboarding vendors added AI assistants per undated vendor comparison pages; timing not verified.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence was found beyond the launch post claim that users get stuck.

branding.domain_note: Company site zeroframe.ai returned 404; product site andoria.ai.

brand_strength.rationale: The legal name Zeroframe differs from the product name Andoria and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Zeroframe, the company behind the Andoria onboarding agent, was a two person team from the MultiOn ecosystem in Fall 2024. YC lists it inactive and its site returns not found, but no cause or funding is public, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Website returned 404. First competitor search used the company name and returned unrelated results; a second search on Andoria found only undated and 2026 vendor pages, so the list is empty. Funding search found nothing for this company. Launch post named in YC page was not opened for rival mentions.
